qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-I (Medical): MBBS/MVSc/BDS from a recognized University. Preference will be given to candidates with previous research experience in public health programs/ICMR/DST/DBT projects, experience in educational settings and multidisciplinary teams, coordinating skills, and good oral/written communication skills in English/Assamese. Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda): BAMS (Ayurvedacharya) from any recognized university (preferred) & Valid registration of related state board/ Council or Central council/ NCISM. Preference will be given to candidates with higher qualifications or previous research experience in public health programs/ICMR/DST/DBT projects, and working knowledge in computer applications. Project Technical Support (III) MSW: Masters in Social work from a recognized university + Three years' experience in relevant subject. Experience in educational settings and with multidisciplinary teams, coordinating skills, and good oral/written communication skills in English/Assamese are preferred. Project Technical support-I (Lab technician): 10th + diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) from a recognized institution + two years' experience in relevant subject/field. Project Nurse III: B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized university with three years of work experience in the relevant field and valid registration with any State Nursing council OR M.Sc. Nursing from a recognized university with valid registration with any State Nursing Council.

salary_details.details: Project Research Scientist-I (Medical): ₹ 67,000/+20% HRA = Rs 80,400 per month Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda): Rs 42,000 + 20% HRA = Rs 50,400 per month Project Technical Support (III) MSW: ₹28,000/ +20% HRA = Rs 33,600 per month Project Technical support-I (Lab technician): ₹18,000/+20% HRA = Rs 21,600 per month Project Nurse III: Rs 28,000 + 20% HRA = Rs 33,600 per month

selection_process: Application submission Shortlisting of candidates Interview/Written Test Document verification Final selection

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026 is 09 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for various project-based positions at AIIMS Guwahati, including Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda), Project Technical Support (III) MSW, Project Technical support-I (Lab technician), and Project Nurse III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post is MBBS/MVSc/BDS from a recognized University. Preference will be given to candidates with relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical support-I (Lab technician) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical support-I (Lab technician) post is 28 years. For most other posts, the maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse III position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Nurse III position is Rs 28,000 plus 20% HRA, totaling Rs 33,600 per month. This is a temporary, project-based role.
